name: Clockwork Sign
story: Tock has two direction signs and a tray of spare clock parts. Crossed sockets belong to moving gears, so keep them clear.
objective: Rebuild three clock signs without using crossed gear sockets.
twist: Forbidden sockets force you to solve the depth ambiguity while a strict cube budget rewards reuse.
rule: Match both panels exactly within the cube budget. Crossed sockets cannot hold cubes. Removal refunds a cube.
controls: Arrows: move. E/Q: raise/lower. Space: add/remove. U: undo. Crossed sockets are blocked.
ending: The clock ticks again; Tock proudly points both signs toward the chime.

puzzles.name: The winding lever
puzzles.story: Tock leaves one moving gear socket crossed. Shift the lever into another depth.
puzzles.payoff: The winding lever clicks into place.

puzzles.name: A bridge for the chime
puzzles.story: The chime bridge must avoid three gear teeth. All six spare cubes must cast useful shadows.
puzzles.payoff: The chime reaches its hanging bell.

puzzles.name: Two directions at once
puzzles.story: Two direction signs share the same spare parts. The crossed sockets hint which depth is safe.
puzzles.payoff: Both signs point toward the clock.
